law_name: Anti-Coercion Instrument (Regulation (EU) 2023/2675 on the protection of the Union and its Member States from economic coercion by third countries)
area: EU trade policy / external economic relations
description: Vedrenne was the European Parliament's lead negotiator (co-rapporteur, with Bernd Lange) on the Anti-Coercion Instrument (ACI), a tool allowing the EU to respond to economic blackmail or coercion by non-EU countries through countermeasures. The INTA committee adopted its position in October 2022; Parliament and Council reached a political agreement on 6 June 2023; MEPs approved the final text on 3 October 2023.
significance: A landmark addition to the EU's trade-defence toolkit, giving the Union a deterrent against economic pressure from third countries. Widely cited as Vedrenne's flagship legislative achievement as an MEP.

law_name: Amendment of Regulation (EU) No 654/2014 concerning the exercise of the Union's rights for the application and enforcement of international trade rules
description: Vedrenne was rapporteur for the European Parliament on the revision of the EU Trade Enforcement Regulation (report A9-0133/2020, adopted 6 July 2020 in INTA). The revision broadened the EU's ability to take trade countermeasures, including in services and intellectual property, and where the WTO dispute system is blocked. This work laid the groundwork for the later Anti-Coercion Instrument.
significance: Strengthened the EU's autonomous trade-enforcement capacity and established Vedrenne as a leading parliamentary voice on trade defence.

law_name: Report on engaging with citizens: the right to petition, the right to refer to the European Ombudsman and the European Citizens' Initiative
description: Vedrenne was rapporteur for this own-initiative report of the Committee on Petitions (A9-0018/2022, adopted 3 February 2022), examining how citizens engage with the EU through petitions, the European Ombudsman and the European Citizens' Initiative.
significance: Reflects her interest in European citizenship and participatory democracy, themes connected to her later national portfolio on Citizenship.

law_name: Net-Zero Industry Act (NZIA) - EMPL committee opinion
description: Vedrenne was rapporteur for the Committee on Employment and Social Affairs (EMPL) opinion on the Net-Zero Industry Act (EMPL_AD(2023)749069, 9 October 2023), focusing on the skills and net-zero academies dimension of the regulation.
significance: Shaped the employment, training and skills provisions of a major EU green-industrial-policy regulation.
